reason: Hypothesis B proposes a specific, testable feedback mechanism (wear removes oxide → galvanic corrosion at interphase boundaries → weakened cohesion → more wear) with a clear controlled comparison (wear+corrosion vs. corrosion-only) and a decisive falsification criterion, directly addressing the coupled degradation question. Hypothesis A is less specific, relies on a pre-oxidation intervention that may not isolate the proposed cyclic breakdown mechanism, and its falsification rule (10% reduction) is arbitrary and less directly tied to the mechanistic claim.
